text:
Mira Patel: Heads up — we need to finalize ownership + deliverables for the AWS / GCP / Azure marketplace listings this week. Legal wants EULA + data processing notes, Product needs SKU mapping and feature bullets, Marketing needs localized logos and size variants. Can we assign owners and a cutover date?
Alex Chen: I can draft the ownership matrix. thinking csv with columns: cloud, artifact_type, owner, deadline, notes.
Sam G: I’ll take GCP packaging + roles doc. @Mira — do we have an existing GCP product ID to reuse?
Mira Patel: Not for GCP, Sam. Product asked to avoid reusing trial SKUs; they want new IDs per cloud. deadline = Fri EOD if possible.
Jen Ortiz: Legal side — Claire flagged we need the updated SaaS addendum + export control checklist. Claire, can you confirm the specific EULA version we should include?
Claire (legal): Confirmed — use EULA v3.2 (internal link: https://redwood/legal/eula/v3.2). Also include the Data Processing Addendum (DPA v2025). I can drop the DPA svg to the repo by Thu.
Dan Mkt: For logos: need 3 sizes (512, 256, 128) + a mono-white variant for dark storefronts. I’ll provide localized taglines for US/EU/APAC by Thursday.
Alex Chen: sample CSV snippet I’ll put in the thread to copy:
```
cloud,artifact_type,owner,deadline,notes
aws,product_page,jenny.product,2025-06-20,include hero CTA & trial
gcp,packaging,Sam G,2025-06-20,verify service account perms
azure,legal,Claire (legal),2025-06-20,attach DPA v2025
```
Sam G: Thanks — I’ll confirm IAM perms with eng-iam and add the packaging manifest.
Jen Ortiz: Claire — once you drop the DPA file can we get a short checklist of customer-facing changes? helps partner ops and sales.
Claire (legal): Yes, I’ll add a 1-page checklist (fields changed, retention notes, export flags) with the file.
Mira Patel: OK action items: Alex = ownership CSV (by Wed morning), Sam = GCP packaging + IAM check (Thu), Claire = DPA + checklist (Thu), Dan = logos + copy (Thu), Jen = legal verification & publish checklist flow (Fri). If anyone can’t hit these dates ping me.
Alex Chen: I’ll create the spreadsheet in partnership drive and @mention all owners once done.
Dan Mkt: Will share artboard links once exports are ready.
Jen Ortiz: Noted. I’ll draft the publish runbook for each cloud and share for review by Fri AM.
Mira Patel: Great — can we have a 20m sync Thu 10am to do a final sweep? If that works I’ll calendar invite.
Sam G: Works for me.
Claire (legal): I’ll block it.
Alex Chen: invite received, thanks.
Mira Patel: Thanks team — let’s keep this thread for updates and small check-ins. :thumbsup:
